description.short: Ask in any language or dialect: a story card that reads itself aloud
description.full: CosmoPolite answers in the language you write in, dialects included. Ask about a place, a person or an idea and get a short story card: written in your language, with a fitting photo from open collections and its credit, in one of five designs and three layouts, light or dark, and read aloud with your browser's voices. Made by Stefan Bauer · N8D.
